candidates.label: Detailed Arabic Quran addressed to a people who know
candidates.definition: In 41:3: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Quran for a people who know.

evidence.excerpt: كِتَٰبٞ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Claimed heart-coverings and partition answered by human likeness and revealed oneness
candidates.definition: In 41:5-6: They say our hearts are within coverings and in our ears is deafness and between us and you is a partition; say I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God, so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا فِيٓ أَكِنَّةٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَآ إِلَيۡهِ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقۡرٞ وَمِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا وَبَيۡنِكَ حِجَابٞ فَٱعۡمَلۡ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَٱسۡتَقِيمُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوهُۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Withholding zakah paired with Hereafter-disbelief as the associators' profile
candidates.definition: In 41:7: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Staged cosmic creation with willing compliance of heaven and earth
candidates.definition: In 41:9-12: Do you disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days; He placed mountains and determined sustenance in four days; then directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said come willingly or by compulsion, they said we come willingly; and completed them as seven heavens in two days inspiring each its command.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ مِن فَوۡقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقۡوَٰتَهَا فِيٓ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَيَّامٖ سَوَآءٗ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٞ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡأَرۡضِ ٱئۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا أَوۡ كَرۡهٗا قَالَتَآ أَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَاتٖ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَأَوۡحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمۡرَهَاۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفۡظٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Strength-boast answered by the Creator's greater strength
candidates.definition: In 41:15: As for Aad they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said who is greater than us in strength; did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength?

evidence.excerpt: فَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Preferring blindness over guidance after guidance was given
candidates.definition: In 41:17: And as for Thamud We guided them but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَٱسۡتَحَبُّواْ ٱلۡعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Bodily faculties testifying against their owners at the Fire
candidates.definition: In 41:20-21: When they reach it their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them; and they say to their skins why have you testified against us, they say we were made to speak by Allah who made everything speak.

evidence.excerpt: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Sam', absar and julud as witnesses.

candidates.label: Assumption of limited divine knowledge named as the cause of ruin
candidates.definition: In 41:22-23: You were not covering yourselves lest your hearing or sight or skins testify against you, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do; and that was your assumption about your Lord, it has brought you to ruin.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَذَٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمۡ أَرۡدَىٰكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Noisy disruption during recitation as an organised suppression tactic
candidates.definition: In 41:26: And those who disbelieve say do not listen to this Quran and speak noisily during it that perhaps you may overcome.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Steadfastness after declaring Allah as Lord earning angelic descent and Paradise tidings
candidates.definition: In 41:30-32: Indeed those who have said our Lord is Allah and then remained on a right course, the angels descend upon them saying do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise; we were your allies in worldly life and the Hereafter; as accommodation from a Forgiving and Merciful Lord.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: نُزُلٗا مِّنۡ غَفُورٖ رَّحِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Best speech defined as invitation to Allah with righteousness and declared submission
candidates.definition: In 41:33: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says indeed I am of the Muslims.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلٗا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Repelling evil with better transforming enmity into devoted friendship
candidates.definition: In 41:34-35: Not equal are the good deed and the bad; repel by that which is better and thereupon the one between whom and you is enmity becomes as a devoted friend; but none is granted it except those who are patient and one having a great portion of good.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٞ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Prostration reserved to the Creator rather than the celestial signs
candidates.definition: In 41:37: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon; do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon but prostrate to Allah who created them.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُۚ لَا تَسۡجُدُواْ لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Earth revived by rain as proof of giving life to the dead
candidates.definition: In 41:39: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled but when We send down rain upon it it quivers and grows; indeed He who gave it life is the Giver of Life to the dead.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ خَٰشِعَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Mighty Book inaccessible to falsehood from before or behind
candidates.definition: In 41:41-42: Indeed it is a mighty Book; falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it, a revelation from a Wise and Praiseworthy Lord.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا يَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦۖ تَنزِيلٞ مِّنۡ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Quran as guidance and cure for believers against deafness and blindness for others
candidates.definition: In 41:44: Say it is for those who believe a guidance and cure; and those who do not believe, in their ears is deafness and it is upon them blindness, those are being called from a distant place.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيّٗا لَّقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓۖ ءَا۬عۡجَمِيّٞ وَعَرَبِيّٞۗ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدٗى وَشِفَآءٞۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٞ وَهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًىۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hour-knowledge and hidden natural processes reserved to Allah alone
candidates.definition: In 41:47: To Him alone is attributed knowledge of the Hour; and fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge.

evidence.excerpt: ۞إِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِۚ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِي قَالُوٓاْ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَامِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Tireless supplication for good turned to despair when evil touches
candidates.definition: In 41:49: Man is not weary of supplication for good things, but if evil touches him he is hopeless and despairing.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا يَسۡـَٔمُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٞ قَنُوطٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Mercy after adversity misread as entitlement with denial of the Hour
candidates.definition: In 41:50: And if We let him taste mercy after adversity he will surely say this is due to me and I do not think the Hour will occur, and even if I am returned to my Lord indeed for me there will be the best.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِي وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةٗ وَلَئِن رُّجِعۡتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓ إِنَّ لِي عِندَهُۥ لَلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Signs in the horizons and within themselves until truth becomes clear
candidates.definition: In 41:53: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth; but is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is over all things a Witness?

evidence.excerpt: سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِي ٱلۡأٓفَاقِ وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
